# Gatling Plasma: New mods and plans

![Gatling Plasma: New Mods and Plans](/uploads/437_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The popular Gatling Plasma gets 6 new mods with this update.

The mods are available both loosely and as a blueprint.

### Gatling Plasma Mods Blueprints

- Blueprint: Gatling plasma (large core container)
- Blueprint: Gatling Plasma (biting core container)
- Blueprint: Gatling plasma (rapid core container)
- Blueprint: Gatling plasma (accelerator nozzle)
- Blueprint: Gatling plasma (gamma wave emitter)
- Blueprint: Gatling plasma (calibrated capacitor)

One of these blueprints can drop as loot from the following containers (if you have learned the "Gatling Plasma" blueprint):

- **State aid call**
 (3% list / 0.5% individual drop chance)
 Also at "Event:**Collision Course** "
- **Secure Transport Container** (Nuclear Missile Key Cards)
(3% list / 0.5% individual drop chance)
- **Skyline Valley Mystery Box** (Collector Murmrgh in Milestone Zero)
 (3.75% list / 0.625% single drop chance)
Not active yet.

### Gatling Plasma Mods (Loose)

- Gatling plasma (rifled barrel)
- Gatling plasma (beam bundler)
- Gatling plasma (beam spreader)
- Gatling plasma (fast-paced core container)
- Gatling plasma (large core container)
- Gatling plasma (gamma wave emitter)
- Gatling plasma (flamethrower nozzle)
- Gatling plasma (accelerator nozzle)
- Gatling plasma (calibrated capacitor)
- Gatling plasma (biting core container)

You can get the loose mods randomly in addition to the mods for 32 other ranged weapons:

- Brotherhood Trader Bots
- Ally Del Lawson (Brotherhood) 
(Gatling Plasma Mods and also Enclave Plasma Mods)
- Free States Trader Bots
- Raider dealer bots
- Crater: Ae-Ri
- Responder dealer bots

So always check the dealers at the train stations and in Whitespring to see whether there are interesting mods in stock. However, the chance of loose mods here is less than 1%.

You also have a chance of getting mods (approx. 3%) at the “Event: **Flyswatter**”.
